s1_grade = pd.to_numeric(df['Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)

s2_enrolled = pd.to_numeric(df['Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
s2_approved = pd.to_numeric(df['Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
s2_without_eval = pd.to_numeric(df['Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
s2_grade = pd.to_numeric(df['Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'], errors='coerce').fillna(0.0)

unemp = pd.to_numeric(df['Unemployment rate'], errors='coerce')
gdp = pd.to_numeric(df['GDP'], errors='coerce')
infl = pd.to_numeric(df['Inflation rate'], errors='coerce')

debtor = pd.to_numeric(df['Debtor'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
tuition_up_to_date = pd.to_numeric(df['Tuition fees up to date'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

assert ((debtor + tuition_up_to_date) == 1).all()
# ASSERTION_END
finance_clear = 1 - debtor
# Semester 1 constraints near use
# ASSERTION_START
assert (s1_approved <= s1_enrolled).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# ASSERTION_START
assert (s1_without_eval <= s1_enrolled).all()
# ASSERTION_END
evaluated_units_s1 = (s1_enrolled - s1_without_eval)
# ASSERTION_START
mask_enroll_zero_s1 = (s1_enrolled == 0)
assert (s1_grade[mask_enroll_zero_s1] == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# ASSERTION_START
assert (s1_approved[s1_without_eval == s1_enrolled] == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Semester 2 constraints near use
# ASSERTION_START
assert (s2_approved <= s2_enrolled).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# ASSERTION_START
assert (s2_without_eval <= s2_enrolled).all()
# ASSERTION_END
evaluated_units_s2 = (s2_enrolled - s2_without_eval)
# ASSERTION_START
mask_enroll_zero_s2 = (s2_enrolled == 0)
assert (s2_grade[mask_enroll_zero_s2] == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# ASSERTION_START
assert (s2_approved[s2_without_eval == s2_enrolled] == 0).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Macro constraints and use
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df.groupby('Unemployment rate')['GDP'].nunique() == 1).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# ASSERTION_START
assert (df.groupby('Unemployment rate')['Inflation rate'].nunique() == 1).all()
# ASSERTION_END
# Build deterministic mappings and rely on them to re-derive GDP/Inflation from Unemployment
u_to_gdp = df.drop_duplicates(['Unemployment rate', 'GDP']).set_index('Unemployment rate')['GDP']
u_to_infl = df.drop_duplicates(['Unemployment rate', 'Inflation rate']).set_index('Unemployment rate')['Inflation rate']

inferred_gdp = unemp.map(u_to_gdp)
inferred_infl = unemp.map(u_to_infl)
# Use inferred macro values downstream to ensure reliance on determinism
macro_gdp = inferred_gdp
macro_infl = inferred_infl

# Progress and quality features
pass_ratio_s1 = (s1_approved / s1_enrolled.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
pass_ratio_s2 = (s2_approved / s2_enrolled.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)

engagement_s1 = (evaluated_units_s1 / s1_enrolled.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(1.0).clip(0, 1)
engagement_s2 = (evaluated_units_s2 / s2_enrolled.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(1.0).clip(0, 1)

grade_per_unit_s1 = (s1_grade / s1_enrolled.clip(lower=1)).clip(lower=0)
grade_per_unit_s2 = (s2_grade / s2_enrolled.clip(lower=1)).clip(lower=0)

grade_norm_s1 = (grade_per_unit_s1 / 20.0).clip(0, 1)
grade_norm_s2 = (grade_per_unit_s2 / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

progress = 0.5 * (pass_ratio_s1 + pass_ratio_s2)
engagement = 0.5 * (engagement_s1 + engagement_s2)
grade_component = 0.5 * (grade_norm_s1 + grade_norm_s2)

u_rank = unemp.rank(pct=True)
gdp_rank = macro_gdp.rank(pct=True)
infl_rank = macro_infl.rank(pct=True)
macro_component = (0.5 * u_rank + 0.2 * infl_rank + 0.3 * (1 - gdp_rank)).fillna(0.5).clip(0, 1)

financial_risk = 1 - finance_clear

# Combine to dropout risk score
# Heavier weight on progress and engagement; financial and macro add-ons
risk_score = (
    0.4 * (1 - progress) +
    0.25 * (1 - engagement) +
    0.2 * (1 - grade_component) +
    0.1 * financial_risk +
    0.05 * macro_component
).clip(0, 1)

threshold_high = 0.7
risk_flag = (risk_score >= threshold_high).astype(int)

run_date = date.today()
week_start = run_date - timedelta(days=run_date.weekday())
week_end = week_start + timedelta(days=6)

out = pd.DataFrame({
    'student_index': df.index,
    'week_start': week_start.isoformat(),
    'week_end': week_end.isoformat(),
    'dropout_risk_score': risk_score.round(4),
    'high_risk_flag': risk_flag
})

out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'dropout_risk_scores.csv')
out.to_csv(out_path, index=False)
